clippings.speaker: Tony Leung Chiu-wai
clippings.quote: One day I spoke to Kar-wai and said: “Can I play a bad guy?” The reason why I want to get close to this woman is I want to make a revenge on her, try to manipulate this woman.
clippings.title: Interview with Tony Leung
clippings.context: Interviewed by Trish Maunder in Australia while promoting In the Mood for Love; Leung describes asking Wong mid-shoot to make his character a bad guy.

clippings.speaker: Tony Leung Chiu-wai
clippings.quote: You need to make yourself very flexible with Kar-wai. You have to turn yourself inside out.
clippings.title: I Told Kar-wai I Couldn't Move, Couldn't Breathe
clippings.context: Web-only TIME Asia interview at the film's release, in which Leung explains how he worked on Wong's unscripted sets.

clippings.speaker: Tony Leung Chiu-wai
clippings.quote: The most interesting thing… is that even though you come to know your character very well by the time you're done shooting, you never have any idea what the story is about.
clippings.title: Interview: Wong Kar Wai
clippings.context: KPBS arts profile by Beth Accomando quoting Leung on Wong's habit of restructuring the story in the edit.

clippings.speaker: Tony Leung Chiu-wai
clippings.quote: If it weren’t for Wong Kar-wai, and me being in that situation with no way back, I wouldn’t have found the courage to take on the challenge of playing this kind of character.
clippings.title: Everything Is Illusion: Tony Leung on drifting between the lines of cinema and reality for the most memorable roles of his five-decade career
clippings.context: Isaac Feldberg interview for Silent Friend's US release; Leung on Wong pushing him to play Lai as a gay character in Happy Together. Interview was conducted with translation assistance.

clippings.speaker: Wong Kar-wai
clippings.quote: The one thing that I will say is once you work with actors and actresses like Tony, who I've worked with before, I know how high they can fly.
clippings.title: Interview: Wong Kar-Wai, Tony Leung And Zhang Ziyi Talk THE GRANDMASTER
clippings.context: New York press roundtable for The Grandmaster, where Wong explains why he cast Leung again.

clippings.speaker: Wong Kar-wai
clippings.quote: ‘2046’ is a story about a love story, about the writer Tony Leung himself.
clippings.title: Strange Yet Cool: Listening to Wong Kar Wai…and Making Sense of “2046”
clippings.context: Wong speaking at a New York event in June 2005 about 2046 and the character Leung plays; the remark is about the character, not the working relationship.

notes: Wong-side is thin: only two verifiable Wong quotes about Leung; Filmmaker Magazine (403), Hollywood Reporter (451) and Vogue Singapore (403) were blocked, so skipped. Leung-side is rich; the Letterboxd Happy Together line was verified from the raw page.
